Exact rational checker independently verifies finite algebra; it does not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: Section 5 of the primary work highlights quantitative entropy control as a natural next issue. A complete counterexample to positive lower bounds determined just by interval width, even after fixing the expected maximal lift displacement exactly, delineates which assumptions are insufficient. The explicit two-map iid construction and exact time-thinning equality quantitatively identify the rare-activation mechanism; this goes beyond a relabeling or a finite parameter test.
